VOTABLE.DESCRIPTION: This services provides 1D spectra from DR5 of LAMOST (Large Sky Area Multi-Object Fiber Spectroscopic Telescope) through SSAP; data is served both in VO-standard SDM and, via datalink, the original SDSS-inspired FITS described in http://dr5.lamost.org/doc/data-production-description .

INFO.name: sql_query
INFO.value: SELECT raj2000 AS nuc_ra, dej2000 AS nuc_dec, t.accref, t.owner, t.embargo, t.mime, t.accsize, t.ssa_dstitle, t.ssa_creatordid, t.ssa_pubdid, t.ssa_cdate, t.ssa_pdate, t.ssa_bandpass, t.ssa_cversion, t.ssa_targname, t.ssa_targclass, t.ssa_redshift, t.ssa_targetpos, t.ssa_snr, t.ssa_location, t.ssa_aperture, t.ssa_dateobs, t.ssa_timeext, t.ssa_specmid, t.ssa_specext, t.ssa_specstart, t.ssa_specend, t.ssa_length, t.raj2000, t.dej2000, t.ssa_targsubclass FROM lamost5.data AS t WHERE raj2000 BETWEEN 194.711503133 AND 194.717580867 AND dej2000 BETWEEN 23.921333222 AND 23.926888778 LIMIT 100

RESOURCE.INFO: ADQL query translated to local SQL (for debugging)

INFO.name: query
INFO.value: SELECT TOP 100 raj2000 AS nuc_ra,dej2000 AS nuc_dec,t.* FROM lamost5.data AS t WHERE raj2000 BETWEEN 194.711503133 AND 194.717580867 AND dej2000 BETWEEN 23.921333222 AND 23.926888778
